summary:
Reviewed w185's commits aef1793b, a0f2b5ba and ce5c1bfb (the report's c0b69237, 159c7530 and 2b29d748, rewritten when merged; subjects and changes match).
The only change under features/ is the retired deprecated r83 scenario. No test was removed or weakened. The setup allowance holds.
Two Important findings, triaged fix now:
(1) an apply round's change list skips r107's unknown-capability check. Its entries for other capabilities are dropped without a word, and a list naming only other capabilities empties the proposal's adds, changes and removes.
(2) under r115 a refused round stops the rounds of the initiative's other proposals, against r115 and r111 and the plan's D4.
Minor: an unreadable apply list is ignored; no scenario pins route(); stub_claude.py is outside the file set; stale docstrings; a step defined twice.
Checks: ruff has 3 hits on lines the commits did not change, vulture is clean, no import contracts, size prints nothing.
questions: Important, scripts/supervise_rounds.py:126-131 (rewrite_lists in supervise_change.py:52): an apply round's change list naming an unknown capability is silently dropped and work run exits successfully, against r107; a list naming only other capabilities empties the proposal's lists

Important, scripts/supervise.py:205-213 and supervise_rounds.py:62-67: a refused round stops rounds(), so the initiative's other due proposals get no round before the error, against r115 and r111 (the plan's D4 had them run)
